title: Common Workplace Accidents and Prevention Measures
what_it_is: Common Workplace Accidents and Prevention Measures

sections.label: Construction workplace fatalities questions
sections.summary: An MP asked about construction-related workplace fatalities over five years, the local-foreign worker ratio, and the Ministry's plan to reduce them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) what is the number of construction-related workplace fatalities for the past five years; (b) what is the local-foreign worker ratio of these fatalities; and (c) what is the Ministry's plan to further reduce the number of construction-related workplace fatalities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This is slightly more than the 19 cases in the same period last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Besides the construction sector, recent fatal accidents were also prevalent in the manufacturing sector and in commercial diving.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: One common cause of the fatalities was the use of improper work methods.

sections.label: Construction fatalities decline and enforcement
sections.summary: Construction workplace fatalities fell from 34 in 2013 to 12 in 2017, foreigners were 88% of fatalities, and MOM ramped up site inspections.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Overall, workplace fatalities in the construction sector have declined over the last five years, from 34 in 2013 to 12 in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: On average, foreigners constituted 88% of the fatalities, even though they comprised 75% of the construction workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To guard against complacency, and to prevent injuries to both local and foreign workers, MOM has ramped up enforcement operations at construction sites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: By the end of the year, MOM would have inspected about 70% of all active construction sites.
